name.full: Snowflake Data Connector for Copilot Cowork

description.short: Ask questions of your governed Snowflake data from Copilot Cowork.
description.full: Connects Copilot Cowork to your Snowflake account (hosted on Azure) through the Snowflake-managed MCP server. Cowork can use the Cortex Agents, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search and SQL tools that your Snowflake administrator exposes. Every request runs as the signed-in user's Snowflake role, so Snowflake role-based access control always applies.

agentConnectors.description: Governed access to Snowflake data and Cortex tools through the Snowflake-managed MCP server.
